speak.title: Role-play: a fake video of me
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: A friend made a joke video of you using AI. Your voice and face look real and people have started sharing it. Ask the website manager to remove it today. Explain why it matters to you.

b.text: You run a video website. The video may be a joke, and you don't want to limit free speech. Ask at least two questions. You can remove it, keep it, or add a clear label.

phrases: I'd like you to remove this video today.
I never said that, and I didn't agree to it.
It's a joke, so is it really harmful?
Who made it, and did you give permission?
We could add a label saying it's AI.
I'm afraid I can't promise that, but I'll look into it.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: was the video removed, and was that a fair decision?
